errors.text: The predicted fracture morphology is reversed: the target associates HPHT treatment with distributed isolated microcracks rather than elongated interfacial cracks, whereas the generated hypothesis predicts elongated cracks for the treated sample and assigns isolated microcracks to the baseline.

The quantitative mechanical outcome is not reconstructed: the target reports approximately 1150 MPa strength and 36% uniform elongation, while the hypothesis gives only broad thresholds of greater than 1.0 GPa and greater than 20%.
